tools.name: ledger
tools.description: Findings earlier review cycles in this repository settled without fixing: deferred, rebutted, left alone on purpose, or raised as questions. Each entry has an id, path, line, kind, finding, reason, source, `date` (when a cycle last settled it), `changed` (whether its file differs from what the last cycle to carry it reviewed; null when the working tree could not be read), and `stale` (settled more than 90 days ago); unless `changed` is false it also has `blob` and `current`, short ids for `git diff <blob> <current>`. Entries come ranked, in an answer of at most 8000 characters unless its first entry and the answer's header together are longer: first every stale entry, query or not, since it is open again, then those holding the most `query` words, then the newest. `reopened` counts the stale entries, `matched` the rest, and `next`, when present, is the `offset` that reads on. `unreadable` counts stored entries this version cannot read; the next record drops them. Read-only.

tools.name: ledger_record
tools.description: Records what a review cycle settled without fixing into this repository's findings ledger. `entries` adds findings, each stamped with its file's blob in the working tree and today's date, so every path must be a file there; text is collapsed to one line and clipped at 400 characters, and the same finding at the same path replaces its entry. `keep` carries entries by id: each gets its file's current blob and keeps its date, and one whose file is gone is dropped. `resolve` removes entries by id. The ledger keeps the newest entries that fit in 384 KiB per repository, and ledgers for the 10 most recently recorded repositories.

tools.name: scratch
tools.description: Makes this review cycle's scratch directory and returns its path. Every reviewer leg makes its private directory inside it with mktemp -d <path>/leg.XXXXXX, so mcp__review-cycle__sweep can end what the legs left running there and remove it, including what a stalled or dropped leg never cleaned up.

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Ends every process still running in, or naming a path inside, a scratch directory mcp__review-cycle__scratch made this session, then removes the directory. Call it once the cycle ends, after every leg reported, was dropped, or was stopped. Reports per directory how many processes it ended, whether it removed the directory, and any errors; a directory it could not remove stays listed for the next sweep.

tools.name: codex_log
tools.description: Reads a `codex review` output file and lists every command Codex ran, in order: the command, its working directory, `status` (`succeeded`, `exited`, `rejected` when Codex refused to run it, or `unfinished` when the log ends with no status for it), `exitCode`, `durationMs`, `guessed` (true when overlapping commands, or a log without color, leave it unclear which command a status belongs to), `masked` (true when the command chains parts with `;`, a newline, `||`, `|` or `&`, so its exit code is only the last part's), and the first and last non-empty lines of its output, each clipped at 200 characters. Answers with an error, not an empty list, for a file that is not a Codex log. Build the Codex leg's execution receipt from this, not from its verdict. Read-only.

tools.name: status
tools.description: review-cycle's view of the working tree: which changed paths a reviewer has seen, which were edited after the last review or never reviewed, and whether a push or a pull request may run now: asked for in the user's latest message, or below their stop-before setting. Read-only.

tools.name: misses
tools.description: The gate's refusals of a push, pull request, merge or release that the user's latest message, or the offer it answered, named: candidate rows for the consent grammar's spec. Each has the message, the offer (the answer's last lines, when the message replied to it), the steps named and the refusal. Read-only; kept in memory until Claude Code restarts.
